text: うみのもの　とも　やまのもの　とも　わからない　しんいり　さん！

structure.jp: うみのもの　とも　やまのもの　とも　わからない
structure.en: who can't be told to be a thing of the sea or a thing of the mountains

patterns.name: 〜とも〜とも
patterns.span: うみのもの　とも　やまのもの　とも
patterns.explanation: AともBとも with a 'not' verb means 'neither as A nor as B'. The whole line is a set saying for someone whose worth is still unknown. うみのもの　とも　やまのもの　とも　わからない = 'can't tell if it's a thing of the sea or of the mountains'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: わからない　しんいり
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb put right before a noun describes that noun. わからない　しんいり = 'a newcomer nobody can figure out'.
